what_this_is: Which later work orders moved a market out from under a CONSUMED historical deployment authorization. An authorization is immutable evidence of what was authorized and deployed at the time; later legitimate source growth must NOT make its historical hash read as corrupt. So a test that re-verifies a historical authorization skips exactly the markets named here -- named, never blanket -- and still binds every market that was not moved. A market may only be listed with the work order that moved it.
